title: Page actions: Copy Markdown, View as Markdown, Open in AI assistants
description: Standard front-end component (on by default for article/guide pages, configurable per site): primary 'Copy Markdown' (purpose-built page Markdown with title and canonical URL), dropdown 'View as Markdown' and optional 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity' (prompt with the canonical URL only; explicit user action). Accessible menu button, theme tokens, no-JS fallback link. Pairs with agent-readable pages PPY-f172d7.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-21 (curl, data-papyrus-page-actions present): articles on anth.us and pilobol.us; guide/docs pages on kanb.us /docs/getting-started.html, pr.ospect.us /guides/start, tactus.anth.us /getting-started/, chattic.us /features/approvals/, cyclotron.anth.us /pricing, apricity.anth.us /articles/about/, p.apyr.us /standard-front-end.html; and every page of the Markus, Biblicus, Kanbus and Cyclotron docs (crawls: 26/98/31/30 pages, 0 missing, 404 pages have none). Core: Papyrus PR #461 (pageActions.types, docs-site builder), #468 (page.page_actions for page_body hooks). Absent by design: home and listings; distinctive-mark.com (pageActions.enabled false on purpose); leaderboards (no article pages). Copy Markdown, View as Markdown, no-JS link fallback; AI links are a per-site option and no live site enables them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reopened 2026-10-21: Ryan's requirement includes Open in ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity; no site enables pageActions.ai yet.
